texts:
Tuesday's notes, team by team: Philadelphia's backfield after Monday night, two claims for this week and a stack of practice watches.

#FlyEaglesFly Saquon Barkley

#RaiseHail Antonio Williams

#JetUp Omar Cooper Jr.

Let's get into it.

#FlyEaglesFly Saquon Barkley tweaked the hamstring on his first carry vs DAL Monday, then hurt his back and sat the fourth quarter. He says neither keeps him out Sunday night vs WAS.

RB18 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's Eagles injury report.

#FlyEaglesFly Dameon Pierce led Philadelphia with 14 carries for 47 and a TD Monday, then left late with an undisclosed injury.

Bigsby and Shipley are on IR and Steele was waived, so Pierce is the handcuff. RB70 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's Eagles report.

#RavensFlock Lamar Jackson is expected to play Sunday at Buffalo after three straight missed games with the high ankle sprain, per Ian Rapoport, who said he is close to 100 percent.

QB6 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's Ravens practice report.

#GoPackGo Matthew Golden sat out Tuesday's walkthrough with the shoulder and foot, his second straight missed session before Thursday vs CAR. He drew 12 targets at Detroit in Week 7.

WR14 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's final Packers injury report.

#TitanUp Tony Pollard ran 25 times for 129 and 3 TDs vs CLE on 75 percent of the snaps with Tyjae Spears (knee) inactive.

Spears is RB59 rest of season for me. Monitor his practice Wednesday to Friday; his return puts Pollard back on his old share.

#KeepPounding Jalen Coker was a full participant Tuesday with the shoulder, per ESPN's Mike Kaye, a day after he was limited. Carolina plays Thursday at Green Bay.

WR20 rest of season for me. Hold him; only a downgrade on Wednesday's final report changes that.

#NYGiants Tyrone Tracy Jr. went on injured reserve Tuesday with the hamstring he hurt at Houston, so he misses at least four games. Cam Skattebo has the backfield after the Week 8 bye.

Tracy is RB63 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the wire.

#WhoDey Erick All Jr. went on injured reserve Tuesday with the right knee he hurt vs BAL, and a torn ACL is feared, per Ian Rapoport.

TE53 rest of season for me. Drop him.

#PhinsUp Jaylen Wright left the win at the Jets with a quad injury after 8 snaps and 6 carries for 8 yards. Week 8 vs NE is open.

RB60 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's Dolphins practice report.

#PhinsUp Ollie Gordon II played 83 percent of the snaps at the Jets and ran 25 times for 103 and a TD, his fourth straight game with a score.

RB19 rest of season for me. Add him.

#RaiseHail Antonio Williams played 45 snaps at SF in Week 6, the most of any Washington receiver, and Dan Quinn says more chances are coming with McLaurin out for the season.

WR46 rest of season for me. Claim him.

#JetUp Omar Cooper Jr. ran a route on 70 percent of the dropbacks to Adonai Mitchell's 55 and caught 5 for 115 and a TD.

WR35 rest of season for me. Claim him.

Garrett Wilson had 3 targets on 50 snaps. WR13 for me; hold him.

#ForTheShoe Jonathan Taylor played 41 snaps and ran for 95 and a TD, and the Colts have not ruled out a trade after moving Quenton Nelson. RB6 rest of season for me; hold him.

Seth McGowan is a deadline bet on 18 snaps. RB74; stash him in deep leagues, 1 to 3 percent.

#Seahawks Zach Charbonnet is trending toward his debut Monday vs CHI. RB37 rest of season for me. Monitor Seattle's practice reports, then Monday's inactives.

Jadarian Price will be designated to return from IR this week. RB37; keep him stashed.

#JetUp Breece Hall missed a fourth straight game with the quad and is targeting Sunday vs LV.

RB23 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's Jets practice report.

#BirdGang Jeremiyah Love practices Wednesday with the ankle after missing two games, per Mike LaFleur, with Sunday at DAL the target.

RB21 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's Cardinals practice report.

#BillsMafia DJ Moore missed Weeks 5 and 6 with the AC joint sprain before the bye, and all signs point to him playing vs BAL Sunday.

WR27 rest of season for me. Hold him; only a missed practice this week changes that.

#OnePride Amon-Ra St. Brown tweaked an ankle in the win over GB, and Dan Campbell says he should be ready to practice Thursday.

WR4 rest of season for me. Monitor Thursday's Lions practice report.

#WeAreTheKrewe Emeka Egbuka is questionable for the Atlanta game with concussion and foot injuries, and Todd Bowles will know more after Thursday.

WR33 rest of season for me. Monitor Thursday's Buccaneers practice report.

#BroncosCountry Jaylen Waddle left late at ARI with chest and shoulder injuries after a season-low 56 percent of the snaps. Week 8 vs KC rides on Thursday and Friday practice.

WR39 rest of season for me. Monitor Friday's Broncos injury report.

#BoltUp Ladd McConkey worked in a non-contact jersey Monday after the bye, still in the concussion protocol.

WR34 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's Chargers practice report for full contact.

#DUUUVAL Brian Thomas Jr. has 0 catches on 5 targets and a 43 percent snap share over his last two games, and Jacksonville is reported to be weighing a trade.

WR66 rest of season for me. Monitor the trade wire through Nov 10 at 4 PM ET.

#FTTB Kaelon Black ran 12 times for 63 and a TD at ATL, but Christian McCaffrey's hamstring strain is mild and he is on track for Week 9. Hold McCaffrey.

Black is RB46 rest of season for me. Stash him only in deep leagues, 0 to 2 percent.

Every Tuesday note is on the Pass, and Wednesday's Menu sets the Week 8 ranks.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy so the Menu lands in your feed, and repost this for your league.
